remarks: Welcome to a truly enchanting opportunity nestled in the coveted Old Hill neighborhood of Westport, CT.Some special features of this 1912 home that help tell its story of a bygone era are the sun drenched loft -like Great Room with it's enormous window offering northern light exposure. It was an artist's studio in the past.This magical space is divided into many living areas & has infinite opportunities. The large , light drenched living room/dining room has high beamed ceilings & walls of long ,elegant windows with transoms. The very large working fireplace has a hand painted map of Wright Street over the mantel. The room leads into a delightful sun porch that also leads off the eat-in kitchen. Set on its own private lane, this home cannot be seen from the road, offering you a unique sense of seclusion & tranquility.The expansive 1.44 acre lot presents a perfect blend of level & gently sloping terrain in the back providing an idyllic backdrop for outdoor gatherings.The winter views of downtown Westport & the Saugatuck River add a picturesque touch. The privacy afforded by the lush surroundings creates a peaceful & romantic retreat from it all.One of the property's enticing aspects is its unbeatable location, an easy walk to down town Westport .This rare antique gem is a canvas awaiting your personal touch. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of Westport's history & experience the enchanting character, delightful features & endless possibilities for this exquisite find!
